name: ZombieSimulationOntology
description: Concepts, relations, rules, and the required code interface for a simplified zombie simulation (no graphics).

Agent.description: Anything that moves in the world.

Human.description: Moves in a straight line at its own speed and bounces off the walls.

Zombie.description: Chases the nearest human it can see.

World.description: Holds the map size, every agent, the frame number, and the random number generator.

relations.name: chases
relations.rule: Each step, a zombie moves toward the nearest human within VISION_RADIUS at ZOMBIE_SPEED. If no human is within VISION_RADIUS, the zombie stays still.

relations.name: bites
relations.rule: If a zombie is closer than TOUCH_DISTANCE to a human, they fight. With probability FIGHT_CHANCE the zombie is destroyed. Otherwise the human is removed and a new zombie appears at the human's position. A human can be in at most one fight per step.

constraints.rule: Every agent stays inside the world: 0 <= x <= width and 0 <= y <= height, after every step.
Every human is slower than every zombie: each human's speed is between HUMAN_SPEED_MIN and HUMAN_SPEED_MAX, and each zombie's speed is ZOMBIE_SPEED.
Agent ids are unique, and no id belongs to both a human and a zombie.
The total number of agents never increases from one step to the next.
A zombie moves at most ZOMBIE_SPEED per step.
Two worlds created with the same seed give identical results after the same number of steps.

count.returns: tuple: (number of humans, number of zombies)
